name: sql-server-safety
description: Always-on SQL Server correctness rules for diagnostic, verification, and data-fix scripts: NOLOCK exceptions, CTE materialization, sargability, read-only/mutate script discipline, session-scoped temp-table cleanup, REPLICATE() truncation, and a local fault-injection decision table for retry testing.

source.title: SQL Server Safety Baseline
source.relationship: Mirrored from the work toolkit's sql-server-safety pack — the underlying facts are SQL Server technical correctness, not employer-specific, so this personal copy applies the same rules to any T-SQL work outside work.
